sloka: इमं मुहूर्तं दुःखानां द्रक्ष्यस्यन्तमनिन्दिते ।तावुभौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ राजपुत्रौ महाबलौ ।। ५.३८.५२।।।।
transliteration: imaṁ muhūrtaṁ duḥkhānāṁ drakṣyasyantamanindite ।tāvubhau puruṣavyāghrau rājaputrau mahābalau ।। 5.38.52।।।।

translations.english: "Both the mighty brothers, tigers among men, are eager to see you. Both the princes will reduce this Lanka into ashes.
